_comment: C4 -- hand-edited role multipliers, keyed by nba_id. engine.projection._role_trend_mult reads a player's minutes trajectory and CANNOT know a player changed teams; after an active offseason it projects a fading role for players who just landed a bigger one (and vice versa).

APPLIED in project_players() AFTER _role_trend_mult and REPLACING it -- the value here becomes the effective role_mult that scales the projected volume line. The model's own minutes-trajectory result is still computed and recorded as role_trend_mult, and both are shown by `cli/board.py --explain` so an override is never silent.

Keys starting with '_' are ignored by load_role_overrides(). Put rationale in _notes (nba_id -> free text). Multipliers are floats > 0; sane band is roughly 0.80 - 1.20 (same clamp _role_trend_mult uses), though nothing enforces it here.

Find candidates:  python -m cli.board --role-audit --league leagues/standard_9cat.json  -- lists players who changed teams between 2025-26 and 2026-27, ranked by projected value, marking who already has an override.
Ships empty: an override is a claim about a specific player's real role that has to be made by hand, not guessed. Add entries as you work the draft.
